title: Sea the City Hot Tub Boat

services.name: Dinner Cruise
services.desc: Private hot tub boat cruises past the Lincoln Memorial. BYOB. 90 minutes of unforgettable. “One of the most fun experiences I’ve had since moving to DC! Loved having our own tub and our own music while cruising down the river.” Would you like to see the iconic Lincoln Memorial in a completely different way? Book a tour of DC’s waterways and float past the Lincoln Memorial as you relax and unwind in our one-of-a-kind hot tub boat. Get breathtaking, unique views of the nation’s capital while enjoying the opulence of the Lincoln Memorial hot tub boat cruise. Whether you’re looking for the perfect date night or a way to celebrate a birthday, no other tour offers this mixture of ultimate comfort
